entry.en: Brazil requires the passport to have an expiry date at least 6 months after the arrival date.
entry.es: Brasil exige que el pasaporte tenga una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Brazil, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more brought into Brazil must be declared online.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viajero por valor de 10.000 dólares estadounidenses o más que se lleven a Brasil deben declararse en línea.
entry.quote: If you are bringing cash or travellers cheques into Brazil with a value of 10,000 US dollars or more, you will need to declare it online.

entry.en: Border control should stamp your passport, and without a stamp you may be fined when you leave.
entry.es: Control fronterizo debe sellar tu pasaporte, y sin sello podrías recibir una multa al salir.
entry.quote: Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport. If it is not stamped, you may be fined when you leave.

entry.en: By law you must show your outbound ticket on entry.
entry.es: Por ley debes presentar tu billete de salida al entrar.
entry.quote: By law you are required to produce your outbound ticket upon entry.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination and certificate are needed when travelling to Brazil from certain tropical regions.
entry.es: Se necesitan la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla y su certificado al viajar a Brasil desde ciertas regiones tropicales.
entry.quote: When you are travelling from certain tropical regions to Brazil you need a yellow fever vaccination and the certificate showing you had this.

entry.en: It is illegal to bring animals, meat, dairy, seeds, plants, eggs, honey, fruit or any non-processed food into Brazil without a permit.
entry.es: Es ilegal ingresar a Brasil animales, carne, lácteos, semillas, plantas, huevos, miel, fruta o alimentos sin procesar sin un permiso.
entry.quote: It is illegal to bring in animals, meat, dairy, seeds, plants, eggs, honey, fruit, or any non-processed food without a permit.

safety.en: FCDO advises avoiding all favelas, including favela tours and accommodation, restaurants or bars advertised as being in a favela.
safety.es: El FCDO aconseja evitar todas las favelas, incluidos los tours por favelas y alojamientos, restaurantes o bares anunciados como situados en una favela.
safety.quote: avoid all favelas, including favela tours marketed to tourists and any accommodation, restaurants or bars advertised as being within a favela

safety.en: Robberies are common in many Brazilian cities, particularly on buses, and thieves target mobile phones especially between 4pm and 9pm.
safety.es: Los robos son comunes en muchas ciudades brasileñas, sobre todo en autobuses, y los ladrones buscan teléfonos móviles en especial entre las 16:00 y las 21:00.
safety.quote: Robberies are common in many cities, particularly on buses. Thieves target mobile phones, particularly between 4pm and 9pm.

safety.en: Bank and credit card scams, including card cloning at ATMs and in shops, are common in Brazil.
safety.es: Las estafas bancarias y con tarjetas de crédito, incluida la clonación de tarjetas en cajeros y tiendas, son comunes en Brasil.
safety.quote: Bank and credit card scams are common in Brazil, including card cloning from ATMs and in shops.

safety.en: There are reports of express kidnappings, assaults and robberies from unlicensed taxis, and FCDO says not to hail taxis on the street.
safety.es: Hay informes de secuestros exprés, agresiones y robos en taxis sin licencia, y el FCDO dice que no se debe parar taxis en la calle.
safety.quote: There have been reports of express kidnappings, assaults and robberies from unlicensed taxis, including in cars using fraudulent ride-hailing accounts, such as Uber. Do not hail taxis on the street.

safety.en: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness in Brazil caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol.
safety.es: En Brasil ha habido muertes y casos de enfermedad grave causados por bebidas alcohólicas que contienen metanol.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Brazil.

safety.en: All electronic cigarettes and vaping devices, including refills, parts and accessories, are illegal in Brazil.
safety.es: Todos los cigarrillos electrónicos y dispositivos de vapeo, incluidos recambios, piezas y accesorios, son ilegales en Brasil.
safety.quote: All electronic cigarettes and vaping devices are illegal in Brazil, including refills, parts and accessories.

health.en: Vaccination against yellow fever and anti-malaria medication may be necessary for Mato Grosso or the northern Amazon regions.
health.es: La vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla y la medicación antipalúdica pueden ser necesarias en Mato Grosso o en las regiones amazónicas del norte.
health.quote: Vaccination against yellow fever and taking anti-malaria medication may be necessary if you are travelling to the Midwestern state of Mato Grosso or the northern (Amazon) regions.

health.en: Tap water varies from place to place, from contaminated, saline or heavily chlorinated to actually drinkable.
health.es: El agua del grifo varía según el lugar, desde contaminada, salina o con mucho cloro hasta realmente potable.
health.quote: Tap water varies from place to place, (from contaminated, saline or saturated with chlorine to actually drinkable)

health.en: Food from street and beach vendors has a bad hygienic reputation in Brazil.
health.es: La comida de vendedores ambulantes y de playa tiene mala fama de higiene en Brasil.
health.quote: Food from street and beach vendors has a bad hygienic reputation in Brazil.

health.en: Foreign nationals are entitled to emergency medical treatment in Brazilian public hospitals.
health.es: Los extranjeros tienen derecho a atención médica de urgencia en los hospitales públicos brasileños.
health.quote: Foreign nationals are entitled to emergency medical treatment in Brazilian public hospitals.

health.en: Private hospitals will not accept you unless you can show enough money or insurance to cover your treatment.
health.es: Los hospitales privados no te aceptan a menos que demuestres tener dinero o seguro suficiente para cubrir el tratamiento.
health.quote: Private hospitals will not accept you unless you can show evidence of enough money or insurance to cover your treatment.

health.en: Bring enough medication for the whole trip, since some medicines may not be available locally.
health.es: Lleva medicación suficiente para todo el viaje, ya que algunos medicamentos pueden no estar disponibles localmente.
health.quote: Bring enough to last your whole trip, as some medicines may not be available locally.

help.en: Emergency numbers in Brazil are 192 for ambulance, 193 for fire and 190 or 911 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Brasil son 192 para ambulancia, 193 para bomberos y 190 u 911 para la policía.

help.en: Crime victims should contact the local police on 190 or the nearest British embassy or consulate.
help.es: Las víctimas de un delito deben contactar a la policía local al 190 o a la embajada o consulado británico más cercano.
help.quote: If you’re the victim of crime, contact the local police number 190 or the nearest British embassy or consulate.

getting_in.en: The two main international gateways to Brazil are São Paulo-Guarulhos (GRU) and Rio de Janeiro-Galeão (GIG) airports.
getting_in.es: Las dos principales puertas de entrada internacionales a Brasil son los aeropuertos de São Paulo-Guarulhos (GRU) y Río de Janeiro-Galeão (GIG).
getting_in.quote: The two main international gateways to Brazil are São Paulo-Guarulhos International Airport (GRU IATA) and Rio de Janeiro-Galeão International Airport (GIG IATA).

getting_in.en: A smaller number of international flights serve other capitals such as Belém, Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Manaus, Porto Alegre and Recife, as well as Campinas.
getting_in.es: Un número menor de vuelos internacionales llega a otras capitales como Belém, Belo Horizonte, Brasilia, Fortaleza, Manaos, Porto Alegre y Recife, además de Campinas.
getting_in.quote: A smaller number of international flights are available to other Brazilian capitals, such as Belém, Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Manaus, Porto Alegre and Recife, as well as Campinas.

getting_in.en: In border towns such as Foz do Iguaçu, no entry or exit stamps are needed for a day trip into the neighbouring country.
getting_in.es: En ciudades fronterizas como Foz do Iguaçu no se necesitan sellos de entrada o salida para una excursión de un día al país vecino.
getting_in.quote: In certain border towns, notably Foz do Iguaçu/Ciudad del Este/Puerto Iguazu, you do not need entry/exit stamps or other formalities for a daytrip into the neighbouring country.

getting_in.en: Long-distance bus service connects Brazil to its neighbouring countries.
getting_in.es: Un servicio de autobuses de larga distancia conecta Brasil con sus países vecinos.
getting_in.quote: Long-distance bus service connects Brazil to its neighboring countries.

getting_in.en: Amazon river boats connect northern Brazil with Peru, Venezuela and Colombia.
getting_in.es: Barcos fluviales del Amazonas conectan el norte de Brasil con Perú, Venezuela y Colombia.
getting_in.quote: Amazon river boats connect northern Brazil with Peru, Venezuela and Colombia.

getting_around.en: The largest Brazilian carriers are LATAM Airlines and the low-cost airlines Gol and Azul.
getting_around.es: Las mayores aerolíneas brasileñas son LATAM Airlines y las de bajo costo Gol y Azul.
getting_around.quote: The largest Brazilian carriers are the flag carrier LATAM Airlines and low-cost airlines Gol and Azul.

getting_around.en: Brazil has a very good long-distance bus network.
getting_around.es: Brasil tiene una red de autobuses de larga distancia muy buena.
getting_around.quote: Brazil has a very good long-distance bus network.

getting_around.en: Few interstate passenger rail lines remain in Brazil after the dismantling of rail transport.
getting_around.es: Quedan pocas líneas ferroviarias interestatales de pasajeros en Brasil tras el desmantelamiento del transporte ferroviario.
getting_around.quote: Today, few interstate passenger lines remain after the dismantling and scrapping of rail transport in Brazil.

getting_around.en: Brazil has the largest road network in Latin America, with over 1.6 million kilometres.
getting_around.es: Brasil tiene la mayor red de carreteras de América Latina, con más de 1,6 millones de kilómetros.
getting_around.quote: Brazil has the largest road network in Latin America with over 1.6 million kilometres.

getting_around.en: In Brazil cars are driven on the right-hand side of the road.
getting_around.es: En Brasil se conduce por el lado derecho de la carretera.
getting_around.quote: In Brazil cars are driven on the right hand side of the road.

getting_around.en: Enormous potholes and varied paving quality strongly discourage night driving.
getting_around.es: Los enormes baches y la calidad variable del pavimento desaconsejan fuertemente conducir de noche.
getting_around.quote: The quality of the paving is very varied, and the presence of enormous potholes is something that strongly discourages night-driving.

money.en: Brazil's currency is the real (R$, ISO code BRL), divided into 100 centavos.
money.es: La moneda de Brasil es el real (R$, código ISO BRL), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: Brazil's unit of currency is the real (pronounced 'hay-AHL'), plural reais ('hay-ICE'), denoted "R$" (ISO code: BRL)

money.en: Cash is used less and less, as in larger cities most transactions are made by credit or debit card and PIX.
money.es: El efectivo se usa cada vez menos, ya que en las ciudades grandes la mayoría de las transacciones se hacen con tarjeta de crédito o débito y PIX.
money.quote: Cash becomes less and less used over the country, as in larger cities most transactions are dealt with credit/debit cards and PIX.

money.en: In smaller towns there may be no ATM that accepts foreign cards.
money.es: En ciudades pequeñas puede que no haya ningún cajero que acepte tarjetas extranjeras.
money.quote: In smaller towns, it is possible that there is no ATM that accepts foreign cards.

money.en: Small shops or street vendors are unlikely to have change for R$50, R$100 or R$200 notes.
money.es: Es poco probable que tiendas pequeñas o vendedores ambulantes tengan cambio para billetes de R$50, R$100 o R$200.
money.quote: Small shops or street vendors are unlikely to have change for R$50, R$100 or R$200 notes.

money.en: Tips are very uncommon in Brazil, though they can sometimes be given for some services, delivery or tourism.
money.es: Las propinas son muy poco comunes en Brasil, aunque a veces se dan por algunos servicios, entregas o turismo.
money.quote: While tips can sometimes be given for some services, delivery or tourism, tips are very uncommon.

money.en: A budget traveler can get by on R$250 to R$400 a day, and R$700 a day gives a little more comfort.
money.es: Un viajero económico puede arreglarse con R$250 a R$400 al día, y con R$700 al día tiene algo más de comodidad.
money.quote: A budget traveler can get by with R$ 250 to R$ 400 a day and have a little more comfort with R$ 700 a day.

etiquette.en: Brazilians are rather casual about time, and contacts may arrive at least 10 to 15 minutes late for any appointment.
etiquette.es: Los brasileños son bastante relajados con la puntualidad y sus contactos pueden llegar al menos 10 a 15 minutos tarde a cualquier cita.
etiquette.quote: Brazilians are rather casual about time. You should expect your Brazilian contacts to arrive at least 10 to 15 minutes late for any appointment.

etiquette.en: Racism is a very serious criminal offence in Brazil.
etiquette.es: El racismo es un delito penal muy grave en Brasil.
etiquette.quote: Racism is a very serious criminal offence in Brazil.

etiquette.en: Brazil is a Portuguese-speaking country, not a Spanish-speaking one, and Brazilians are not Hispanic.
etiquette.es: Brasil es un país de habla portuguesa, no hispanohablante, y los brasileños no son hispanos.
etiquette.quote: Brazilians are not Hispanic. Brazil is a Portuguese-speaking country, not a Spanish-speaking country.

etiquette.en: Foreign criticism of Brazil's government and politicians is seldom appreciated and may be seen as insulting.
etiquette.es: La crítica extranjera al gobierno y los políticos de Brasil rara vez se aprecia y puede verse como un insulto.
etiquette.quote: foreign criticism of Brazil's government and politicians is seldom appreciated and may be seen as insulting.

etiquette.en: Avoid personal questions about religious beliefs, salary or economic status unless you know the person well.
etiquette.es: Evita preguntas personales sobre creencias religiosas, salario o situación económica a menos que conozcas bien a la persona.
etiquette.quote: Do not ask personal questions– religious beliefs, salary, economic status, and so on – unless you know the person well.

etiquette.en: Ignoring someone who tries to start a conversation can be seen as insensitive.
etiquette.es: Ignorar a alguien que intenta iniciar una conversación puede verse como insensible.
etiquette.quote: Ignoring someone when they try to converse with you can be seen as insensitive

connectivity.en: Brazil has four national mobile operators: Vivo, Claro, Oi and TIM.
connectivity.es: Brasil tiene cuatro operadores móviles nacionales: Vivo, Claro, Oi y TIM.
connectivity.quote: Brazil has 4 national mobile operators: Vivo (Telefónica Group), Claro (Telmex/América Móvil Group), Oi and TIM (Telecom Italia Group)

connectivity.en: Pay-as-you-go SIM cards are widely available at newsstands, drugstores, supermarkets and retail shops.
connectivity.es: Las tarjetas SIM de prepago están ampliamente disponibles en quioscos, farmacias, supermercados y tiendas.
connectivity.quote: Pay-as-you-go (pré-pago chip) SIM cards for GSM phones are widely available in places like newsstands, drugstores, supermarkets, retail shops, etc.

connectivity.en: Registering a pay-as-you-go SIM card requires a CPF (Brazilian tax ID), which is more limited for tourists.
connectivity.es: Registrar una SIM de prepago requiere un CPF (identificación fiscal brasileña), lo cual es más limitado para turistas.
connectivity.quote: However, you can only register a pay-as-you-go SIM card if you have a CPF (Brazilian tax ID). It is more limited if you are a tourist
